questions.title: Instructions
questions.body: To be completed daily, with all questions fully answered, before midnight.

questions.description: Just a simple description of how you spent your free time for the day.
List what you drank today, excluding water.
A short summary of what you watched is sufficient.
If "yes" provide a brief description, I will judge =p
Note how long you spent in chastity today. If you are required to be in chastity, calculate and note the remaining time in the box. If you've completed your chastity today, note "Free."

questions.title: Reminder:
questions.body: Your chastity hours only count once this survey has been submitted - if it's not in a screenshot on the discord server, you're not done.

questions.description: Note down particularly strong feelings, especially related to commands I gave you. If none, write none.
List all time you spent doing tasks/chores assigned by me. Note down what you did, or select '0' if none.

questions.prompt: What is the current word count of your book?

questions.title: The End!
questions.body: Post your results, as an image, in the discord server.
